enum lpn_cb_type_t

Types of callbacks for LPN operations.

Values:

enumerator LPN_CB_TYPE_ESTABLISH_SUCCESS

Establishment success callback type.

enumerator LPN_CB_TYPE_ESTABLISH_FAIL_NO_OFFER

enumerator LPN_CB_TYPE_ESTABLISH_FAIL_NO_UPDATE

struct lpn_req_params_t

Structure defining parameters for LPN request operations.

Public Members

uint32_t poll_interval

Polling interval in units of 100 milliseconds, must be less than poll_timeout.

uint32_t poll_timeout

Timeout period in units of 100 milliseconds, range: 0x00000A - C0x34BBFF.

frnd_criteria_t criteria

Criteria for selecting suitable friend offers.

pf_lpn_offer_choose_t offer_choose

Algorithm for selecting offers. User can define offer choose algorithm or set to NULL to use stack's default offer choose algorithm.
